description: What it does: lists the Data APIs you can call (free public sources and provider-listed paid ones). Call it when: you need an id and example params before call_data_api. List the Data APIs callable with call_data_api: id, name, publisher, what it covers, example params and price tag (free | paid). Free Data APIs are public no-key sources; paid ones are listed by their providers and settle per call over x402 (USDC on Base).
name: list_data_apis
